name: Flourish
intro: This is where I cook properly. Whole foods, and a bit more prep.

fl-eggs.label: The eggs
fl-eggs.moment: From the farm up the road. The hens are laying well this week.
moments: Brown eggs, mostly. The hens don't take requests.
I keep them out of the fridge. Hard to say why.

fl-greens.label: The greens
fl-greens.moment: Kale and parsley, picked twenty minutes ago.

fl-range.label: The range
fl-range.moment: I light it first thing and it stays lit all day. The big pan lives on it.

fl-food-processor.label: The food processor
fl-food-processor.moment: Pesto, hummus, a quick pastry crumb. It saves my knuckles a lot of chopping.
moments: Mind the blade when you wash it. I say that to everyone.

fl-air-fryer.label: The air fryer
fl-air-fryer.moment: Crisp potatoes in twenty minutes. I was suspicious at first. I've come round.
moments: Shake the basket halfway. It likes to be reminded.
It does a very good job of leftovers.

fl-slow-cooker.label: The slow cooker
fl-slow-cooker.moment: Put it on in the morning and supper mostly takes care of itself.
moments: Don't lift the lid to check. It sulks.
Beans, stews, a big pot of something. It's patient, which I'm not.

fl-bbq.label: The barbecue
fl-bbq.moment: For the days the weather behaves. The lid's hot, so mind your hands.
moments: It sits out by the garden door, waiting for a fine evening.
Corn in its husks, whole fish, sausages. I'm easily pleased.

fl-dresser.label: The kitchen hutch
fl-dresser.moment: Lentils, chickpeas, oats and seeds. Keep these jars full and there's always a good meal.
moments: I top the jars up on the first of the month.

fl-trug.label: The trug
fl-trug.moment: Straight out of the beds. Knock the soil off, but don't wash them until you need them.

fl-herbs.label: The herbs
fl-herbs.ref: the herbs on the window ledge
fl-herbs.moment: Rosemary, thyme and mint. They like the sun on this ledge.

fl-phonograph.label: The phonograph
fl-phonograph.moment: Wind the handle and it plays: Grieg, Vivaldi or Dvořák, depending on the hour.
moments: The records came with the house. I've never bought one, and never wanted to.
It skips on the third track. I've stopped minding.
fl-phonograph.moment_stop: Needle up. That'll do for now.
fl-phonograph.moment_quiet: Give the handle a few turns. Turn the sound on, by the bell, and you'll hear it.

fl-window.label: The sea
fl-window.moment: The same bay you see from Cuddlecore, from the other side of the Inn.
moments: The bay looks different from this side. Same water, though.
I wash this window more than the others. Don't ask me why.

fl-back-door.label: The garden door
fl-back-door.closed: The kitchen garden's for another day. Breathe in, though. That's the rosemary.

atoms.title: Eggs baked on a pan of greens
atoms.hook: Eggs baked into a pan of garlicky greens.
atoms.method_short: Wilt kale or spinach with garlic, crack two eggs into it and put the lid on for four minutes.

seed.name: Eggs baked on garlicky greens
seed.why: Protein and greens in one pan, for breakfast or lunch.

atoms.body: Wilt kale or spinach with garlic, crack two eggs into it and put the lid on for four minutes.

atoms.title: Oats with a spoon of seeds
atoms.hook: Porridge with pumpkin, sunflower and flax seeds stirred in.
atoms.method_short: Your usual porridge or overnight oats, with pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and ground flax stirred in.

seed.name: Seeded porridge with berries
seed.why: Seeds add protein, fibre and good fats, so the bowl lasts longer.

atoms.body: Your usual porridge or overnight oats, with pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and ground flax stirred in.

atoms.title: Red lentil and carrot soup
atoms.hook: Red lentils, carrot and cumin, cooked until they fall apart.
atoms.method_short: Onion and grated carrot, a cup of red lentils, cumin and stock. Twenty minutes, then a squeeze of lemon.

seed.name: Red lentil and carrot soup
seed.why: Pulses and vegetables in a pot that costs very little.

atoms.body: Onion and grated carrot, a cup of red lentils, cumin and stock. Twenty minutes, then a squeeze of lemon.

atoms.title: Roast beetroot and lentil salad
atoms.hook: Roast beetroot, lentils, rocket and feta. Better the next day.
atoms.method_short: Roast beetroot tossed with green lentils, rocket, feta and a mustardy dressing. Better the next day.

seed.name: Roast beetroot, lentil and feta salad
seed.why: Earthy, filling and full of colour.

atoms.body: Roast beetroot tossed with green lentils, rocket, feta and a mustardy dressing. Better the next day.

atoms.title: Whatever's-in-the-trug frittata
atoms.hook: Whatever vegetables you have, set in eggs under the grill.
atoms.method_short: Whatever vegetables you have, six beaten eggs and a little cheese, set gently and finished under the grill.

seed.name: Garden vegetable frittata
seed.why: It uses up the vegetable drawer, and cold slices make lunch.

atoms.body: Whatever vegetables you have, six beaten eggs and a little cheese, set gently and finished under the grill.

atoms.title: A Sunday cook-up for the week
atoms.hook: Grains, roast vegetables and boiled eggs, cooked once for the week.
atoms.method_short: On Sunday, cook a pot of grains, a tray of roast vegetables and some boiled eggs. All week, meals are just putting things together.

seed.name: Sunday meal prep: grains, roast vegetables and eggs
seed.why: An hour once a week means proper food on busy days.

atoms.body: On Sunday, cook a pot of grains, a tray of roast vegetables and some boiled eggs. All week, meals are just putting things together.

atoms.title: Salmon, greens and new potatoes on one tray
atoms.hook: Salmon, green beans and new potatoes on one tray, with lemon.
atoms.method_short: New potatoes roasted for twenty minutes, then salmon and green beans on top for twelve more. Lemon over everything.

seed.name: Salmon and green bean tray bake
seed.why: A whole-food dinner with one tray to wash.

atoms.body: New potatoes roasted for twenty minutes, then salmon and green beans on top for twelve more. Lemon over everything.

atoms.title: Chickpea and spinach curry
atoms.hook: Chickpeas and spinach in a spiced tomato sauce, with rice.
atoms.method_short: Onion, garlic, ginger and curry spices, a tin of chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes and a big handful of spinach. Rice on the side.

seed.name: Chickpea and spinach curry
seed.why: Pulses, greens and warmth for a cold evening.

atoms.body: Onion, garlic, ginger and curry spices, a tin of chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes and a big handful of spinach. Rice on the side.

atoms.title: A grain bowl with roast vegetables
atoms.hook: Quinoa, roast vegetables and chickpeas with a lemony tahini dressing.
atoms.method_short: Quinoa or brown rice, roast vegetables, a few leaves and a lemony tahini dressing. Make extra for tomorrow.

seed.name: Roast vegetable grain bowl with tahini
seed.why: A balanced lunch that keeps well.

atoms.body: Quinoa or brown rice, roast vegetables, a few leaves and a lemony tahini dressing. Make extra for tomorrow.

atoms.title: Tabbouleh with lots of parsley
atoms.hook: Mostly parsley and mint, with a little bulgur, tomato and lemon.
atoms.method_short: Mostly parsley and mint, a little bulgur, tomato, lemon and olive oil.

seed.name: Parsley and mint tabbouleh
seed.why: A whole-food salad that's mostly herbs.

atoms.body: Mostly parsley and mint, a little bulgur, tomato, lemon and olive oil.

atoms.title: A big pot of vegetable soup
atoms.hook: Whatever vegetables need using, slowly simmered into soup.
atoms.method_short: Onion, carrot and celery softened in butter, then whatever vegetables need using and stock to cover. Let it tick over while you get on with something else.

seed.name: Big-batch vegetable soup
seed.why: A week of lunches from the vegetable drawer.

atoms.body: Onion, carrot and celery softened in butter, then whatever vegetables need using and stock to cover. Let it tick over while you get on with something else.

atoms.title: Stock from scraps
atoms.hook: Vegetable scraps from a freezer bag, simmered into stock.
atoms.method_short: Keep onion ends, carrot peel and herb stalks in a freezer bag. When it's full, cover with water and simmer for an hour.

seed.name: Vegetable stock from scraps
seed.why: Free stock, and nothing wasted.

atoms.body: Keep onion ends, carrot peel and herb stalks in a freezer bag. When it's full, cover with water and simmer for an hour.

atoms.title: Green herb salt
atoms.hook: Soft herbs chopped with flaky salt until bright green.
atoms.method_short: Chop a big handful of soft herbs with flaky salt until it's bright green. A pinch wakes up eggs, rice, anything plain.

seed.name: Green herb salt
seed.why: A jar of it makes plain food taste of the garden.

atoms.body: Chop a big handful of soft herbs with flaky salt until it's bright green. A pinch wakes up eggs, rice, anything plain.

atoms.title: Gentle knife skills: the claw
atoms.hook: The claw grip, practised on a chopped salad.
atoms.method_short: Curl your fingertips under so the blade rides against your knuckles. Slow is fine.

seed.name: Chopped salad with a lemon dressing
seed.why: Good knife practice that ends in lunch.

atoms.body: Curl your fingertips under so the blade rides against your knuckles. Slow is fine.

atoms.title: Why a bit of protein at breakfast helps
atoms.hook: Why an egg or some seeds at breakfast keeps you full for longer.
atoms.method_short: Protein and fibre take longer to digest than sugar and white bread, so an egg or a spoon of seeds keeps you full for longer.

seed.name: Spinach and feta omelette
seed.why: A quick breakfast with protein in it.

atoms.body: Protein and fibre take longer to digest than sugar and white bread, so an egg or a spoon of seeds keeps you full for longer.

atoms.title: Why lots of colours on the plate
atoms.hook: A few colours on the plate covers more ground, with no counting.
atoms.method_short: Different coloured vegetables bring different things: beta-carotene in carrots, folate in dark greens. A few colours covers more ground, with no counting.

seed.name: Rainbow vegetable tray bake
seed.why: Five colours on one tray.

atoms.body: Different coloured vegetables bring different things: beta-carotene in carrots, folate in dark greens. A few colours covers more ground, with no counting.

atoms.title: Kale, the cottage-garden green
atoms.hook: Kale stands through frost, and a cold snap makes it sweeter.
atoms.method_short: Cottage gardeners grew kale because it stands through frost and keeps cropping. A cold snap makes the leaves a little sweeter.

seed.name: Kale and white bean stew
seed.why: A winter-garden green in a warm pot.

atoms.body: Cottage gardeners grew kale because it stands through frost and keeps cropping. A cold snap makes the leaves a little sweeter.

atoms.title: What a squeeze of lemon does
atoms.hook: A squeeze of lemon at the end makes flat food taste brighter.
atoms.method_short: Acid makes flavours taste brighter, which is why a squeeze of lemon can rescue a flat soup. Add it at the end, off the heat.

seed.name: Lemon and thyme roast chicken
seed.why: Lemon doing its job in a proper dinner.

atoms.body: Acid makes flavours taste brighter, which is why a squeeze of lemon can rescue a flat soup. Add it at the end, off the heat.

atoms.title: Asparagus with soft eggs and herbs
atoms.hook: Asparagus with soft-boiled eggs to dip, and chives on top.
atoms.method_short: Boil the eggs for six minutes. Steam the asparagus for three. Dip the spears into the eggs, with chives and lemon.

seed.name: Asparagus with soft eggs and chives
seed.why: Spring greens and eggs make a proper breakfast or lunch.

atoms.body: Boil the eggs for six minutes. Steam the asparagus for three. Dip the spears into the eggs, with chives and lemon.

atoms.title: Sweetcorn fritters with tomato salsa
atoms.hook: Sweetcorn fritters, crisp at the edges, with a fresh tomato salsa.
atoms.method_short: Mix sweetcorn with egg, a little flour and coriander, and fry spoonfuls until golden. Serve with chopped tomato and lime.

seed.name: Sweetcorn fritters with tomato salsa
seed.why: Summer sweetcorn, in a proper lunch.

atoms.body: Mix sweetcorn with egg, a little flour and coriander, and fry spoonfuls until golden. Serve with chopped tomato and lime.

atoms.title: Roast kūmara and lentil salad
atoms.hook: Roast kūmara with lentils, spinach and a lemony tahini dressing.
atoms.method_short: Roast cubed kūmara and red onion until soft. Toss with cooked lentils, spinach and tahini thinned with lemon.

seed.name: Roast kūmara, lentil and spinach salad
seed.why: Autumn kūmara with pulses, enough for a meal.

atoms.body: Roast cubed kūmara and red onion until soft. Toss with cooked lentils, spinach and tahini thinned with lemon.

atoms.title: Silverbeet and feta pie
atoms.hook: Silverbeet, feta and egg in crisp filo, sliced warm.
atoms.method_short: Wilt silverbeet with onion, mix with feta and egg, and bake between buttered layers of filo until golden.

seed.name: Silverbeet and feta filo pie
seed.why: Silverbeet grows right through winter, and this uses a whole bunch.

atoms.body: Wilt silverbeet with onion, mix with feta and egg, and bake between buttered layers of filo until golden.

atoms.title: Whitebait fritters
atoms.hook: Whitebait in a light egg batter, fried in small golden fritters.
atoms.method_short: Mix whitebait with beaten eggs and a spoonful of flour. Fry small spoonfuls in butter until golden, and finish with lemon.

seed.name: Whitebait fritters with lemon
seed.why: Whitebait is only in the shops for a few weeks in spring.

atoms.body: Mix whitebait with beaten eggs and a spoonful of flour. Fry small spoonfuls in butter until golden, and finish with lemon.

atoms.title: Kūmara wedges with lime yoghurt
atoms.hook: Kūmara wedges roasted crisp, with lime yoghurt.
atoms.method_short: Cut kūmara into wedges, toss with oil and paprika and roast until crisp at the edges. Stir lime zest and juice into yoghurt for dipping.

seed.name: Kūmara wedges with lime yoghurt
seed.why: Kūmara roasts sweet and crisp, and lime keeps the yoghurt sharp.

atoms.body: Cut kūmara into wedges, toss with oil and paprika and roast until crisp at the edges. Stir lime zest and juice into yoghurt for dipping.

atoms.title: Barbecued lamb chops with rosemary and lemon
atoms.hook: Lamb chops with rosemary, garlic and lemon, grilled until browned.
atoms.method_short: Rub lamb chops with oil, garlic, chopped rosemary and lemon zest. Grill over a hot barbecue for three or four minutes a side, then rest them under foil. Lemon over the top.

seed.name: Barbecued lamb chops with rosemary and lemon
seed.why: Lamb needs salt, a hot grill and a bit of patience.

atoms.body: Rub lamb chops with oil, garlic, chopped rosemary and lemon zest. Grill over a hot barbecue for three or four minutes a side, then rest them under foil. Lemon over the top.

atoms.title: Fish in a foil parcel with tomatoes and lemon
atoms.hook: Fish, tomatoes and lemon sealed in foil and steamed on the grill.
atoms.method_short: Set a fish fillet on foil with halved cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, oil and salt, and fold it into a tight parcel. Barbecue for twelve minutes, and open it away from your face. The steam is hot.

seed.name: Barbecued fish parcels with tomatoes and lemon
seed.why: One parcel each, and nothing to wash but the plate.

atoms.body: Set a fish fillet on foil with halved cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, oil and salt, and fold it into a tight parcel. Barbecue for twelve minutes, and open it away from your face. The steam is hot.

atoms.title: Charred corn with lime butter
atoms.hook: Sweetcorn grilled until it chars in spots, with lime butter.
atoms.method_short: Grill the cobs, turning, until charred in spots, about ten minutes. Brush with butter, squeeze lime over and add salt and coriander.

seed.name: Barbecued corn with lime butter
seed.why: Sweetcorn is at its best with a bit of char on it.

atoms.body: Grill the cobs, turning, until charred in spots, about ten minutes. Brush with butter, squeeze lime over and add salt and coriander.

atoms.title: Courgette, capsicum and red onion skewers
atoms.hook: Chunky vegetables on skewers, charred, with yoghurt and lemon.
atoms.method_short: Thread chunky courgette, capsicum and red onion on skewers and brush with oil and oregano. Grill, turning, until soft and charred at the edges, then serve with yoghurt and lemon. Soak wooden skewers first so they don't burn.

seed.name: Barbecued vegetable skewers with yoghurt and lemon
seed.why: Whatever the garden is overproducing, on a stick.

atoms.body: Thread chunky courgette, capsicum and red onion on skewers and brush with oil and oregano. Grill, turning, until soft and charred at the edges, then serve with yoghurt and lemon. Soak wooden skewers first so they don't burn.

atoms.title: Slow-cooked lamb shoulder with rosemary
atoms.hook: Lamb shoulder left on low until it pulls apart with a fork.
atoms.method_short: Sit the lamb shoulder on sliced onion with garlic, rosemary and salt, lid on, and leave it on low for eight hours. It pulls apart with a fork. Roast or mash some kūmara to go with it.

seed.name: Slow-cooker lamb shoulder with rosemary and garlic
seed.why: Fifteen minutes of work, then the pot does the rest.

atoms.body: Sit the lamb shoulder on sliced onion with garlic, rosemary and salt, lid on, and leave it on low for eight hours. It pulls apart with a fork. Roast or mash some kūmara to go with it.

atoms.title: Chicken, chickpea and apricot tagine
atoms.hook: Chicken thighs, chickpeas and apricots in a gently spiced sauce.
atoms.method_short: Onion, cumin and cinnamon, chicken thighs, a tin of chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes and a handful of chopped apricots, all in the pot. Low for six hours, then stir.

seed.name: Slow-cooker chicken, chickpea and apricot tagine
seed.why: The apricots go sweet and soft, and the sauce looks after itself.

atoms.body: Onion, cumin and cinnamon, chicken thighs, a tin of chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes and a handful of chopped apricots, all in the pot. Low for six hours, then stir.

atoms.title: Pea and ham soup
atoms.hook: Split peas and a ham hock, left on low until the soup is thick.
atoms.method_short: Rinse a cup of split peas and put them in the pot with a ham hock, onion, carrot, celery and water to cover. Six hours on low, then shred the ham back in.

seed.name: Slow-cooker pea and ham soup
seed.why: A Kiwi winter standard, and a very patient one.

atoms.body: Rinse a cup of split peas and put them in the pot with a ham hock, onion, carrot, celery and water to cover. Six hours on low, then shred the ham back in.

atoms.title: Slow-cooker red lentil dal
atoms.hook: Red lentils, ginger and turmeric, cooked soft in the slow cooker.
atoms.method_short: Red lentils, chopped onion, grated ginger and garlic, a tin of tomatoes, turmeric, cumin and water in the pot. Four hours on low, then stir and salt it. Rice or flatbread to go with it.

seed.name: Slow-cooker red lentil dal
seed.why: Lentils soften without any soaking, so this one is nearly all waiting.

atoms.body: Red lentils, chopped onion, grated ginger and garlic, a tin of tomatoes, turmeric, cumin and water in the pot. Four hours on low, then stir and salt it. Rice or flatbread to go with it.

atoms.title: Chilli garlic noodles with a fried egg
atoms.hook: Noodles, garlic, soy and a fried egg on top. Done in fifteen minutes.
atoms.method_short: Boil the noodles while you fry sliced garlic and chilli in oil for a minute. Toss the noodles through with soy and spring onion, and top with a fried egg. Start to finish, fifteen minutes.

seed.name: Chilli garlic noodles with a fried egg
seed.why: Quicker than the delivery driver finds your street.

atoms.body: Boil the noodles while you fry sliced garlic and chilli in oil for a minute. Toss the noodles through with soy and spring onion, and top with a fried egg. Start to finish, fifteen minutes.

atoms.title: Black bean and cheese quesadillas
atoms.hook: Tortillas crisped round beans and cheese, with salsa to dip.
atoms.method_short: Mash the beans a little and spread them with grated cheese over half a tortilla. Fold it and crisp it in a dry pan for two minutes a side. Cut into wedges and dip in salsa.

seed.name: Black bean and cheese quesadillas
seed.why: A pantry dinner that's hot in twelve minutes.

atoms.body: Mash the beans a little and spread them with grated cheese over half a tortilla. Fold it and crisp it in a dry pan for two minutes a side. Cut into wedges and dip in salsa.

atoms.title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry with rice
atoms.hook: Beef strips and broccoli in a garlicky sauce, over microwave rice.
atoms.method_short: Fry the beef in a very hot pan for two minutes and set it aside. Fry the broccoli with garlic and a splash of water, then return the beef with soy sauce and a pinch of sugar. Serve over rice.

seed.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
seed.why: A hot pan and everything cut before you start.

atoms.body: Fry the beef in a very hot pan for two minutes and set it aside. Fry the broccoli with garlic and a splash of water, then return the beef with soy sauce and a pinch of sugar. Serve over rice.

atoms.title: Eggs poached in spiced tomato
atoms.hook: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato sauce, with bread to mop it up.
atoms.method_short: Soften a sliced onion with cumin and paprika, add a tin of tomatoes and simmer for eight minutes. Make dips for the eggs, cover and cook for four minutes. Bread to mop it up.

seed.name: Quick shakshuka
seed.why: One pan, and it looks like you tried.

atoms.body: Soften a sliced onion with cumin and paprika, add a tin of tomatoes and simmer for eight minutes. Make dips for the eggs, cover and cook for four minutes. Bread to mop it up.

atoms.title: Smash burgers with the lot
atoms.hook: Thin, crisp-edged burgers with cheese, pickles and a soft bun.
atoms.method_short: Roll mince into balls and press them flat in a very hot pan for a minute a side. Add cheese for the last few seconds, and build with onion, pickles and a toasted bun.

seed.name: Smash burgers with cheese and pickles
seed.why: Press hard and leave them alone. That's the whole trick.

atoms.body: Roll mince into balls and press them flat in a very hot pan for a minute a side. Add cheese for the last few seconds, and build with onion, pickles and a toasted bun.

atoms.title: Butter chicken, the quick way
atoms.hook: Chicken in a creamy tomato sauce, with rice and flatbread.
atoms.method_short: Fry the chicken thigh pieces with garam masala, add passata and simmer for fifteen minutes. Stir in butter and a spoon of yoghurt at the end. Serve with rice.

seed.name: Quick butter chicken
seed.why: Thirty-five minutes, so slower than delivery, but yours.

atoms.body: Fry the chicken thigh pieces with garam masala, add passata and simmer for fifteen minutes. Stir in butter and a spoon of yoghurt at the end. Serve with rice.

atoms.title: Chicken kebab-style wraps
atoms.hook: Spiced chicken, yoghurt sauce and crunchy salad in warm flatbread.
atoms.wait: 30 minutes marinating, if you have it
atoms.method_short: Toss chicken strips in cumin, paprika, oil and salt, and cook in a hot pan for eight minutes. Stir garlic and lemon into yoghurt, and pile it all into warm flatbread with cucumber and lettuce.

seed.name: Chicken kebab-style wraps with garlic yoghurt
seed.why: Leave the chicken in its spices for half an hour if you can.

atoms.body: Toss chicken strips in cumin, paprika, oil and salt, and cook in a hot pan for eight minutes. Stir garlic and lemon into yoghurt, and pile it all into warm flatbread with cucumber and lettuce.

atoms.title: Pizza toast
atoms.hook: Thick toast with tomato, cheese and your favourite toppings, grilled.
atoms.method_short: Spread thick slices of bread with tomato paste, add cheese and toppings, and grill or air-fry until bubbling and golden at the edges, about seven minutes.

seed.name: Pizza toast with cheese and oregano
seed.why: Pizza night, minus the dough.

atoms.body: Spread thick slices of bread with tomato paste, add cheese and toppings, and grill or air-fry until bubbling and golden at the edges, about seven minutes.

atoms.title: Lasagne to freeze in portions
atoms.hook: A big tray of lasagne, cut up and frozen for the nights you can't.
atoms.method_short: Make a mince and tomato sauce and a white sauce, layer with lasagne sheets and bake. Cool completely, cut into portions and freeze in boxes. Reheat from frozen until steaming hot all the way through.
atoms.freezer: Freezes for up to 3 months. Cool first, portion, and reheat until steaming hot.

seed.name: Freezer-friendly beef lasagne
seed.why: One cook, six dinners.

atoms.body: Make a mince and tomato sauce and a white sauce, layer with lasagne sheets and bake. Cool completely, cut into portions and freeze in boxes. Reheat from frozen until steaming hot all the way through.

atoms.title: Chilli con carne for the freezer
atoms.hook: A big pot of chilli, frozen flat in bags with rice on the side.
atoms.method_short: Brown mince with onion, add cumin, chilli, beans and a tin of tomatoes, and simmer for thirty minutes. Cool, then freeze in flat bags so they thaw quickly.
atoms.freezer: Freezes for up to 3 months, flat in bags. Thaw overnight and reheat until steaming.

seed.name: Batch chilli con carne
seed.why: Better on day two, and fine on day sixty.

atoms.body: Brown mince with onion, add cumin, chilli, beans and a tin of tomatoes, and simmer for thirty minutes. Cool, then freeze in flat bags so they thaw quickly.

atoms.title: A big pot of pumpkin soup for the freezer
atoms.hook: Pumpkin and onion soup, frozen in single portions for the days ahead.
atoms.method_short: Soften onion and garlic, add chunks of pumpkin and stock to cover, and simmer for twenty minutes. Blend until smooth. Cool and freeze in portion-sized bags or tubs, leaving a gap at the top.
atoms.freezer: Freezes for up to 3 months. Leave a gap at the top, thaw overnight and heat until steaming.

seed.name: Batch pumpkin soup
seed.why: A mug of soup from the freezer is a good thing to have.

atoms.body: Soften onion and garlic, add chunks of pumpkin and stock to cover, and simmer for twenty minutes. Blend until smooth. Cool and freeze in portion-sized bags or tubs, leaving a gap at the top.

atoms.title: Bean and rice burritos to freeze
atoms.hook: Burritos wrapped in foil and frozen, ready to reheat in minutes.
atoms.method_short: Mix cooked rice, beans, cheese and salsa, and roll into tortillas. Wrap each in foil, cool, and freeze. Reheat from frozen in the oven, or thaw and microwave, until hot all the way through.
atoms.freezer: Freezes for up to 3 months, wrapped. Reheat until steaming hot throughout.

seed.name: Freezer burritos with beans and rice
seed.why: Your own version of the frozen aisle.

atoms.body: Mix cooked rice, beans, cheese and salsa, and roll into tortillas. Wrap each in foil, cool, and freeze. Reheat from frozen in the oven, or thaw and microwave, until hot all the way through.
